_notes: READY-TO-EDIT optimizer config for MyClaude_V61 — Pass A (signal-edge sweep).
This file is a STARTING POINT. Before running, regenerate indices with the CS6
(Generate Config) button against the live study, then transfer your min/max/increment.
CRITICAL — how this optimizer treats parameters:
* increment > 0  -> the parameter is SWEPT (min..max by increment).
* increment == 0 -> the parameter is IGNORED by the optimizer (NOT set on the study).
You MUST set those inputs MANUALLY in the MyClaude_V61 study settings beforehand.
MANUAL SETUP CHECKLIST (set these in the study; the optimizer will NOT set them):
- Enable Order Submission (idx 35) = Yes
- ALLOW LIVE (idx 36)             = No   (keep simulation interlock)
- FLATTEN NOW (idx 39)            = No
- Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode  = ON   (so orders can NEVER hit a live broker)
- Stop Type (idx 0) = 0 (ATR), Stop ATR x (idx 1) = 2.0
- TP1 Mult (idx 4) = 1.0, TP2 Mult (idx 6) = 1.5, Trail ATR x (idx 8) = 1.5
- Order Quantity (idx 18) = 1 contract (fixed sizing keeps P/L = edge, not size)
- Session/Block times (idx 13/14/20/21) aligned to your instrument's CHART timezone
- Trend Filter MA (idx 40) = 200, Long Only (idx 41) = Yes (or your preference)
REPLAY MODE: keep replayMode = 1 (Standard). The study early-returns on
sc.IsFullRecalculation, so mode 2 (Accurate Back Test) can produce ZERO trades.
Verify ONE combo produces fills (Trade >> Trade Activity Log) before the full grid.
WARM-UP: set startDate a few hundred bars BEFORE the window you care about, so the
200-bar trend MA + Range Filter + RQK + ATR are warmed up before the first entry.
Pass A below = 5 x 5 x 5 = 125 combinations.
